Benchmark v1.2.1 workspace UserTask16 utility bug (#116, fixed only in v1.2.2): user_task_16 logs (gpt-4o: 1 benign + 14 attacked) can score utility False although the task was done; outcomes are kept as logged, but the bug is undisclosed in our profile/artefacts (no entry)

Workspace injection_task_6..13 have an empty ground truth (#213): the tool_knowledge payload for 8 of 14 injection tasks carries no tool sequence, so 320 of the 560 gpt-4o attacked logs ran a weaker attack variant than the name suggests; expected ASR difference between injection tasks 0..5 and 6..13

The 56 'local' logs come from the upstream LocalLLM path with known parse/serve defects (#150, #202, #219, #220): attacks and utility may be under-counted; the census found 0 '<function=' tag mismatches, so a different call syntax (fenced JSON, <tool_call>) or empty final answers would be invisible to the existing quirk

Harness is a locally modified fork (22 changed harness files, 2 added) at a commit between v0.1.34 and v0.1.35, committed 2-3 months after the logs were written (logs 2025-06-18..2025-07-12, commit 2025-09-10): the code at the pin is not necessarily the code that wrote the logs

The local-Qwen arms are fragments (28 attacked cells of 560; 14 of 40 benign; single-task hf runs, both incomplete), consistent with exploratory runs following the upstream README example; any rate from them is anecdotal

Population tallies imply (if the benign security constant is True for all 81 benign logs with outcomes) 91 attack successes among 587 attacked logs with outcomes; hence gpt-4o tool_knowledge ASR must lie in [64/560, 91/560] = [11.4%, 16.3%], far below the v1 all-suite 34.50% context figure; a value outside the bracket means the constant or the census is wrong
